map.浇水周期按品种与季节调整：生长期（春秋）每 7 至 14 天浇透一次，休眠期（夏: The watering cycle adjusts by variety and season: in the growing season (spring and autumn) soak thoroughly every 7 to 14 days, while dormancy (summer and winter) stretches to 20 to 30 days or no water at all; the criterion is dry out then soak, meaning watering once the soil moisture drops below 20% or 2 to 3 days after the potting soil is fully dry; in summer heat and humidity, and when winter temperatures fall below 5 °C, cut back water to prevent root rot, and water in the early morning or evening.

Next watering date = last watering date + the days for the current season.
map.石莲花在春季每 10 天浇一次，上次 3 月 1 日则下次 3 月 11 日；进: Echeveria is watered every 10 days in spring, so a watering on March 1 means the next is March 11; in summer it switches to 15 days, so a watering on June 1 means the next is June 16. Cacti are the opposite: 10 days in the summer growth peak, stretching to 40 days in winter dormancy, which is almost no water.
map.为什么夏季反而要少浇？: Why should you water less in summer?
map.多数多肉（石莲花、景天、生石花等）夏季高温休眠，根系吸水弱，盆土长期潮湿极易黑腐: Most succulents (Echeveria, Sedum, Lithops and so on) go dormant in summer heat, their roots take up water poorly, and potting soil that stays wet for long easily turns black and rots the roots; cut back water and improve ventilation and shading.
map.芦荟、仙人掌为什么夏季浇水更勤？: Why do aloe and cacti need more frequent watering in summer?
map.它们属夏型种，夏季为生长旺季需水较多；冬季低温休眠则要严格控水，避免低温高湿导致: They are summer-type varieties whose peak growth season in summer needs more water; in winter they go dormant at low temperatures and water must be strictly controlled to avoid frost damage and rot.
